title: Scripted readers first
statement: Before a person sees a lesson, have scripted readers play it: one who knows, one who guesses, one who is stuck, and one who tries to game it.
detail:
The reading engine's four scripted readers (strong, guesser, stuck, adversarial) play every lesson the composer builds
(`g9/transformer/src/quality/personas.js`, `g9/transformer/src/quality/playtest.js`); the adversarial one uses the
reading engine's line telling the marker to ignore the rubric. They found the two-tries release that never fired and
the old blocks with line numbers.
against:
they find faults in flow and wording, not whether a lesson teaches, and the
reading engine's harness once silently swapped a scripted reader in for a model one, so a run has to say which it used
